## Stage 2 Design Optimizations ✅ VERIFIED

All 4 Stage 2 design optimizations were successfully implemented:

### 1. ✅ RBAC Extensibility
- Bottom-up permission system (not hardcoded roles)
- 25 permissions defined in `Permission` enum
- `ROLE_PERMISSIONS` maps roles to permission sets
- Easy to add new permissions/roles without breaking existing code

### 2. ✅ Approval Idempotency
- `ApprovalRequest.execution_id` field added
- Prevents duplicate execution of approved operations
- Nullable for backward compatibility

### 3. ✅ Audit Chain Support
- `AuditLog.previous_hash` field for linking
- `AuditLog.event_hash` field for integrity
- Ready for cryptographic audit trail

### 4. ✅ Token Revocation
- `Session.jti` stores JWT ID
- `Session.revoked_at` tracks revocation
- `validate_session()` checks JTI against database
- `revoke_session_by_jti()` implements server-side revocation
